See landmarks of Palm Springs and hear fascinating tales of life in this popular playground. Questions? services.name: Biking Tours
services.desc: The Museums are closed for the summer months. We hope to see you when we reopen in October. As archivist of the vast history of Palm Springs, we work to record, preserve and present the rich history of the Coachella Valley. Being the first established to offer walking and biking tours in the city you can be assured we are diligent in providing historical accuracy along with the fun stories tied to our city.
